use: Measure polymer molecular weight distribution (Mn, Mw, PDI).
simulation: Converted from the polymer chain-length distribution via a PS-standard calibration curve.
notes: GPC / SEC: Agilent 1260 Infinity II GPC/SEC class (PLgel columns, THF mobile phase, refractive index detection, polystyrene standard calibration). Specs not verified.
sources: Agilent GPC/SEC system documentation (narrow-dispersity polystyrene standard calibration; THF 1 mL/min)
to_calibrate: Other polymers need universal calibration or Mark–Houwink parameters (not modelled in the simulation)

inject.description: Inject the sample vial placed on the instrument (dilute polymer with THF to ~1–5 mg/mL first); after ~25 min returns Mn, Mw, PDI (relative to polystyrene standards) and the chromatogram
